_about: v2.5 plan 06 J1 authoring hold-out (the memory-pairs-holdout rule), relabelled in English for v2.6 plan 15 (AS-16) after W25 removed the all-Spanish one. Five English rows over two drafts that no fixture case uses (they live in this file, so authoring.json's frozen cases never saw them), labelled 2026-10-01 BEFORE any model answer was read for any of them. Same scoring as authoring.json (validity, opShape). Scored in both x2 re-runs of `so-role-calibration.mts run --role authoring --holdout` and reported beside the fixture score; they never enter or change the fixture floors. A miss in either run turns the recommended-config row into 'fixture floors met; generalisation not shown', and a run without the hold-out leaves the verdict incomplete. Ids h06-h10 are new so no record of the Spanish h01-h05 can be read as theirs. Do not edit a label after a run; add a row instead.

cases.message: Add an intermediate checkpoint, The Ossuary, where the party discovers the relic is a fake.
Add a final anchor, The Wreck, where the crew abandons the ship carrying the captain's log.
When the story reaches The Crypt, the door should already count as open.
Connect the fog to the deck once the crew has boarded, and the deck to the captain's cabin once they have read the log.
Give The Fog an author's note: the fog swallows every sound.
